raw_segments.text: At last we opened a reach. A rocky cliff appeared, mounds of turned-up
earth by the shore, houses on a hill, others with iron roofs, amongst a waste of excavations,
or hanging to the declivity. A continuous noise of the rapids above hovered
over this scene of inhabited devastation. A lot of people, mostly black and naked, moved
about like ants. A jetty projected into the river. A blinding
sunlight drowned all this at times in a sudden recrudescence of glare.
There's your company's station, said the Swede, pointing to three wooden,
barrack-like structures on the rocky slope. I will send your things up. Four boxes,
